name: Last Dance (CR 10)
body:
A mad aristocrat was isolated in this lavish chamber. The inhabitant’s spirit still haunts the room, yearning to dance, an obsession which was denied to him during his many years of isolation.

XP 9,600; CN haunt (a spacious, richly furnished chamber, 50 feet across); Caster Level 10th; Notice Perception DC 25 (to notice rhythmic tapping of shoes on the floor); hp 20; Trigger proximity; Reset 1 day

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, the shadowy apparition of an elegantly clothed dandy jumps out of a corner and pulls the most attractive person present into a short but frantic irresistible dance (DC 22).

DESTRUCTION

Organizing a series of dances in the chamber for multiple days wears the haunt out.
